description: pcivil.icgc.cat: earthquake hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by pcivil.icgc.cat. Coverage: the area served by pcivil.icgc.cat. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about earthquake hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Superación del umbral de daño sísmico o del de intensidad; Servicio de visualización WMS de riesgo sísmico; Intensidad sísmica esperable (T=500 años). Formats seen: WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://governobert.gencat.cat/ca/dades_obertes/llicencia-oberta-informacio-catalunya/), as linked on the portal listing (https://www.icgc.cat/condicions). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
